transport_of_new_masses: conditional finite matching: fourth charged-lepton/down pole masses are v/sqrt(2) times their threshold Yukawas (also show independent multiplicative factors 0.8 to 1.2 without retuning rho). This is a boundary contract, not four-generation running.
scope: Single Higgs doublet, CP-even, canonical aligned h, known Yukawas and hVV unchanged, no additional hgg/hgammagamma contact or light charged states. Compare first nonzero finite-mass amplitudes to fixed SM templates and published marginal ratios; independent non-Higgs searches and full EW/threshold/UV running are separate.
